I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An Allotment of land in total extent of about 0.0177 Hectare depicted in the Advance Tracing No. B/ELL/2022/231 dated 21.12.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called “Edamegama (F.V.P. 184)” in the Grama Niladhari Division of Hettipola (69G) in the Minor Division of Kumbalwela Koralaye in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ella in Badulla District in Uva Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Maldarawatta – Extent: About 0.0177 Hectare North: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Hettipola Estate claimed by H. M. C. Bandara, Road and Hettipola Estate claimed by R. M. Karunarathna; East: Hettipola Estate claimed by H. M. C. Bandara, Road, Hettipola Estate claimed by R. M. Karunarathna and Maldarawatta claimed by H. M. N. Wijerathna; South: Maldarawatta claimed by H. M. N. Wijerathna; West: Maldarawatta claimed by H. M. N. Wijerathna and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha).
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Reference No.: 4-3/9/2021/PC/416.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.
